fullContentHtml:
Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Last Date Extended - 15,000 Vacancies, Apply Online from 18 August - Complete Details

Karnataka School Education Department has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 15,000 Teacher posts. The online application process will be conducted from 18 August 2026 to 25 September 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date : 12 August 2026 (district-wise gazette notices issued 10–12 August 2026)
  • Notification Release Date : 12 August 2026
  • Online Application Start Date : 18 August 2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 7 September 2026
  • Extended Last Date to Apply Online : 25 September 2026
  • Last Date to Pay Application Fee : 10 September 2026
  • Written Examination Date : To be announced
  • Admit Card Release Date : To be announced
  • SC, ST & Specially Gifted (PwD) Candidates : ₹500

Application Fee

  • Post Names : Graduate Primary Teacher (GPT), Assistant Master (AM), Primary School Teacher (PST), Physical Education Teacher (PET), Computer Science Teacher (CST)
  • Online Application Start Date : 18 August 2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 7 September 2026
  • Extended Last Date to Apply Online : 25 September 2026
  • Last Date to Pay Application Fee : 10 September 2026
  • Post Name : Kalyana Karnataka
  • Assistant Master (AM) : 2,214
  • Primary School Teacher (PST) : 800
  • Computer Science Teacher (CST) : 300
  • General & Backward Class : ₹750
  • SC, ST & Specially Gifted (PwD) Candidates : ₹500

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
